subject: general
question: Arjun and Malaika have to travel from Delhi to Kanpur in their respective cars. Arjun is driving at 60 km/hr while Malaika is driving at 96 km/hr. Find the time taken by Malaika to reach Kanpur if Arjun takes 8 hours.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When **Distance** is constant, **Speed** is inversely proportional to **Time**.

Ratio of Speeds (Arjun : Malaika) = 60 : 96 = 5 : 8

Ratio of Time taken = 8 : 5

Given Arjun takes 8 units = 8 hours, then Malaika takes 5 units = 5 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of **Arjun** (S₁) = 60 km/hr

Time taken by **Arjun** (T₁) = 8 hours

Speed of **Malaika** (S₂) = 96 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea013d36fa14348fc092eb87c21e436dda20d7a6ec1c33148a52f38bfab7ad07.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = Speed of Arjun × Time of Arjun

⇒ Total Distance = 60 × 8 = 480 km

⇒ Time taken by Malaika = Total Distance ÷ Speed of Malaika

⇒ Time taken = 480 ÷ 96

⇒ Time taken = 5 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 5 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportionality Rule

If distance is constant, S₁ × T₁ = S₂ × T₂. This is the fastest way to compare two journeys over the same track.

Average Speed

When two equal distances are covered at speeds 'a' and 'b', the average speed is given by (2ab) ÷ (a + b).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p
